standard_prerequisites.name: Base change of higher direct images along an etale localization, and etale locality of quasi-coherence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, labels spaces-properties-lemma-pushforward-etale-base-change-modules (invoked at proof line 351) and spaces-properties-lemma-characterize-quasi-coherent (invoked at proof line 357)
standard_prerequisites.use: Together they reduce the claim to the case where the target $Y$ is an affine scheme.

standard_prerequisites.name: An affine etale cover of a quasi-compact algebraic space
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, label spaces-properties-lemma-quasi-compact-affine-cover (invoked at proof line 365)
standard_prerequisites.use: It provides the surjective etale morphism $g : U \to X$ with $U$ affine, used to run the induction through the Leray spectral sequence of $f \circ g$.

standard_prerequisites.name: Quasi-coherence of the zeroth direct image
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, label spaces-morphisms-lemma-pushforward (invoked at proof line 385)
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the base case $n = 0$ of the induction $IH_n$.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Leray spectral sequence of a composition
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology on Sites, label sites-cohomology-lemma-relative-Leray (invoked at proof line 396)
standard_prerequisites.use: It relates the higher direct images of $f \circ g$ to those of $f$ and $g$, which is how the induction step is organized.

standard_prerequisites.name: Quasi-coherent modules form a weak Serre subcategory of all modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, label spaces-properties-lemma-properties-quasi-coherent (invoked at proof line 408)
standard_prerequisites.use: It is what upgrades the information from the spectral sequence, all of whose other terms in the relevant degrees are known quasi-coherent, into quasi-coherence of $R^{n+1}f_*g_*\mathcal{H}$.

core_obligations: Reduce to an affine target: pull back along an etale $V \to Y$ with $V$ affine, use that $R^if'_*(\mathcal{F}|_U) = (R^if_*\mathcal{F})|_V$ and that quasi-coherence is etale local (proof lines 347-358).

With $Y$ affine, use quasi-compactness of $f$ to choose a surjective etale $g : U \to X$ from an affine scheme, note that $g$ is representable, separated and quasi-compact so that the lemma is known for $g$, and that it is known for $f \circ g$ as a morphism of affine schemes (proof lines 361-377).
Formulate the induction $IH_n$ stating that $R^if_*\mathcal{F}$ is quasi-coherent for $i \leq n$ and settle $n = 0$ by the quasi-coherence of the pushforward (proof lines 380-386).

Induction step: for quasi-coherent $\mathcal{H}$ on $U$ consider the Leray spectral sequence of $f \circ g$; by $IH_n$ every term of total degree $\leq n+1$ is quasi-coherent except $E_2^{n+1,0} = R^{n+1}f_*g_*\mathcal{H}$, whose outgoing differentials vanish, so the weak Serre property gives quasi-coherence of that term as well (proof lines 388-410).

Transfer to an arbitrary quasi-coherent $\mathcal{F}$ on $X$ via $\mathcal{H} = g^*\mathcal{F}$: the adjunction map is injective with coherency-controlled cokernel $\mathcal{G}$, the long exact sequence together with the previous step gives a two-step filtration of $R^{n+1}f_*\mathcal{F}$, and a second application to $\mathcal{G}$ produces an exact sequence exhibiting $R^{n+1}f_*\mathcal{F}$ as an extension of quasi-coherent modules, settling $IH_{n+1}$ (proof lines 412-451).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to an affine target (proof lines 347-358).
The affine etale cover and the two known cases $g$ and $f \circ g$ (proof lines 361-377).
The induction statement $IH_n$ and its base case (proof lines 380-386).
The induction step through the Leray spectral sequence (proof lines 388-410).
Descent from $g_*g^*\mathcal{F}$ to $\mathcal{F}$ and the conclusion (proof lines 412-451).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that higher direct images of quasi-coherent modules along a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of algebraic spaces remain quasi-coherent (statement lines 338-344). The proof localizes on the target in the etale topology, replaces the source by an affine etale cover, and runs an induction on the cohomological degree in which the Leray spectral sequence of the composite morphism, the vanishing of the outgoing differentials of its corner term and the weak Serre property of quasi-coherent modules give the induction step, after which a two-step filtration argument descends from the cover to an arbitrary quasi-coherent module. The induction through the spectral sequence and the descent are the substance, so the claim is H2.
